mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and gains bonus range.
The bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Crippling Strike deals basic (on-hit applicable) damage but is also tagged as spell damage, triggering spell effects, including on the basic attack itself.
mechanics.quote: ''Crippling Strike'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} but will also trigger {{tip|spell effects}} by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Crippling Strike resets Darius' basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Crippling Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Darius' ''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the effect (attack) resolves, not on cast.
If the empowered attack kills the target, cooldown is reduced and mana cost is refunded (not relevant vs a dummy that never dies mid-fight until the kill).
mechanics.quote: If this attack kills the target, half of ''Crippling Strike's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
